title: At 1536 x 864 a report keeps table rows visible and scrollable under its chart
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A} (for example Admin ShopView), whose role has the Reports permission, at location {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your screen is 1536 x 864 at 100% browser zoom, with the browser window maximised (for example a 1920 x 1080 laptop with the computer's display scaling set to 125%).
  • {Location-A} has more Sales invoices in the last 12 months than fit on one screen (for example more than 30).
  • On the Sales report the chart is shown (the chart button beside the filters reads Hide chart).
custom_steps:
1. Click Reports in the top bar and click Sales in the left menu.
  2. Set the Date control to Last 12 months.
  3. Look under the chart.
  4. Point at the table rows and scroll down with the mouse wheel.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: Table rows are visible under the chart, without zooming out or hiding the chart.
  • Step 4: Only the table rows move. The chart and the filters stay where they are.
  • Step 4: You can scroll down to the last rows of the table.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9584 (Story 12, Visual Conformance); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850, version 48 (14 Oct 2026, 17:09 UTC, Chris Ward), S12-R7 and S12-R8 (added in version 45 on 14 Oct 2026 (15:06 UTC) by Chris Ward, from Chris Ward's answer 13 of 14 Oct 2026 to our question sheet, one rule per defect ticket SV-10933 and SV-10934; the spec's change log (version 46) lists it under 2026-10-14); read 14 Oct 2026. Source-verified 14 October 2026. Not yet checked against a build.
